A week to
recharge energy.

This week was about slowing down. After the noise and excitement of the festa, we needed to find a quiet corner of Amarante to rest and recharge.

The Tâmega river, which runs through the city, became our main spot. We spent hours sitting by its banks, watching the water flow and feeling the cool breeze on our faces. Since the temperatures are rising again, the river was the perfect place to escape the heat.

On this week, we made a lot of night activities with the people of the CJ, activities organised by them, for them. We made some introduction activities for the newcomers, ping-pong tournaments, football matches, and some more activities that we can't even remember.

This place after the festa, became a really quiet city. The streets that were full of music and people, are now calm and empty. It's a completely different vibe, but we also love it. How a city can be so different in just a few days.

Week 3 had us dancing and celebrating until late, week 4 had us sitting by the river, talking and laughing until late. Both were amazing, but in very different ways.

For more photos of this week, check out the gallery!
